monsters.description:

Max HP: ~6       Will: none       AC: +          EV: +                          
Threat: Minor   Class: Natural  Size: V. Small  Int: Mindless

Attack  Max Damage  
Hit     3           

It is immune to acid and corrosion and blinding.
It can see invisible.
It is amorphous and immune to ensnarement.
